## Design

### 2026-10-16 – Oct 15th (before reel recording)

**2.5h**

Oct 15th (before reel recording)

I was hesitant about making the case due to the amount of precision that I would have to use to make all the electronics fit inside perfectly and the lack of time I have left. I started following the Merbl run steps and honestly refreshed my memory of prior 3D modeling software. I decided to use On shape rather than Fusion 360 and others as it is less CPU demanding and I can use it in my browser. I set up a mood board for dimensions and overall looks of Megabot as inspiration. As I'm writing this I'm debating myself on whether or not I should use magnets for the limbs or ball sockets. Both have their pros and cons, with the ball jocket having more tension and the bot being held stiff in place whereas magnets are just cooler overall but won't help serve the purpose of a keychain.
